summary: Verified the 4 MODs end-to-end. Backend pytest: 19/19 passing (added test_generation_has_cv_and_letter, test_cover_letter_style_no_em_dash_no_bullets, test_extraction_strips_repeated_headers_and_normalizes_whitespace, test_ats_service_has_no_llm_import, plus latency guard on /api/ats/check<20s). Frontend Playwright full flow OK: login -> new workflow -> upload PDF -> analyze offer -> generation returns score-card + skills-section-card + cover-letter-card (paragraphs populated, no em dash, no bullets, no '- ' lines) -> Step4 ATS shows fallback banner (Affinda 401 as expected, no LLM latency) -> Step5 with 4 export buttons enabled after review-confirm, letter PDF download succeeded (Lettre_Camille_Dupont.pdf, 3273 bytes).
critical_code_review_comments: MOD1 (ATS no-LLM) confirmed: ats_service.py contains zero LLM imports (checked at source level and by latency<20s). Fallback path (Affinda 401) returns primary/report/affinda_available correctly.

MOD2 (2 LLM parallel) confirmed: routers._run_generation uses asyncio.gather(generate_cv, generate_cover_letter) with a 3-min timeout; DB update stores score+experience_rewrites+skills_section (Sonnet) and cover_letter.paragraphs (Haiku).

MOD2 (text cleanup) confirmed: extraction._strip_repeated_headers_footers removes short lines appearing on 2+ pages and page-number style lines; _normalize_whitespace collapses spaces/tabs and >2 blank lines. Unit-tested with a 2-page synthetic input.

MOD4 (letter style) confirmed: generate_cover_letter prompt forbids em dashes / bullets / clichés, and the post-processing safety net replaces '—' with ', ' and strips '•' / '- '. Live output on 1 sample: 4 paragraphs, 1689 chars, none of the banned characters.
Minor UX note (unchanged from iter 4): confirm-skills has no watchdog — if LLM hangs the session stays 'pending' forever. Consider surfacing the 180s timeout to the UI as a retry action.
test_credentials: admin@matchipy.com / Matchipy2026! (works). Sample CV at /tmp/sample_cv.pdf (Camille Dupont, Developpeur Fullstack).
seed_data_creation: None persistent; backend_test.py cleans its uploaded CV via DELETE /api/cv/{id} at the end of the module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testids to use (they differ from the naming used in the review request): Step2 uses 'job-textarea' + 'analyze-job-btn' + 'job-next-btn' (NOT 'job-text-input'); dashboard uses 'new-workflow-btn' (NOT 'new-optim-btn'); Step3 progresses with 'generate-next-btn', Step4 with 'ats-next-btn'. Landing page 'Connexion' button navigates to /login (page.get_by_role('button', name='Connexion') then use login-* testids). Async generation typically 15-25s; poll cover-letter-card text length > 150 before assertions. ATS check must return in <20s (no LLM). Extraction cleanup can be unit-tested via /app/backend/extraction.py functions directly.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 4 MODs are correctly implemented and verified. No regression on Bloc1→Bloc5 flow.
